shadowSentences: I love to read books every day.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
Traveling to new places is always exciting for me.
I enjoy cooking on weekends when I have more time.
Listening to music helps me relax after a long day.
I often play sports to stay active and meet friends.
Learning new languages opens up many opportunities for me.
I like to volunteer in my community to help others.
Spending time outdoors is great for both my mind and body.
Finding a balance between work and leisure is important for happiness.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable trip you took?
Q2: What were some challenges you faced while traveling?
Q3: How do you think travel impacts personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What types of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you ever struggled to stay motivated to work out?
Q3: In your opinion, why is regular exercise important?
Q4: What tips would you give to someone starting a new fitness routine?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: What is your favorite meal of the day and why?
Q2: Have you encountered any difficulties maintaining healthy eating?
Q3: How do you feel about the role of diet in overall health?
Q4: What recommendations would you make for someone wanting to eat healthier?
